Name: (CP) Pierre Sells Strawberry Seeds
Author: invatorzen
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/Yk1pqXb.png[/img]﻿[/center]
[center]
[size=3]Have you ever wanted Pierre to sell Strawberry Seeds for the whole season of Spring? Well, now he does!

This simple mod [b]requires[/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] to work. [/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][size=3]It was rewritten to no longer require STF, and has a config option to scale the price as well as change the year it is sold.

They are sold for the same price as they would be at the Egg Festival. (100 gold)[/size][/center]

Downloads.Description: This mod was rewritten to no longer require STF. Utilizing only the shop features in CP!
